name: dsh-details-tabs
description: Multi-panel right details column for DeepSeek Harness: a container that owns the single `details` slot and renders registered panels in a Blender-style split layout (side-by-side row/col splits, draggable dividers, drop zones to split/replace/close). Any plugin registering into `details` the native way is auto-mirrored as a panel — zero changes needed on their side.
